question: Did you open and read every file in migrations/? Answer yes or no, then say which files you did not read.
answer: Yes. A single command printed every file in `migrations/` (`0001_init.py` through `0040_vacuum_marker.py`, all 40), and I read the full contents of each one, so there are no files I skipped. Beyond that, I ran a regex grep across `migrations/` and `ledgerly/` to catch anything I might have missed by eye. It found only fixed SQL text, with no input formatted into it.
